newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki Heavy jumps on healthy earnings.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki Heavy jumps on healthy earnings.

text.p: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd jumped in Monday morning trade, propelled by healthy interim earnings, brokers said.
As of 0147 GMT, the shipbuilder's shares were up five yen at 520 yen, with 1.06 million shares traded. It was the fifth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Kawasaki Heavy said on Friday that its parent current profit rose to 12.16 billion yen in the six months to September 30, 1996, from 8.06 billion in the year-ago period.
